_: The provider registry. NOTHING in the engine names a model; it names a CAPABILITY and looks it up here. Swap a row and the whole studio moves without a line of pipeline changing — which is the point, because the model table ages in months and the stages do not.

_capability_contract.refs_max: how many reference images the route holds before identity starts slipping. The compiler will not build a longer set.
_capability_contract.first_frame: true if the route treats image 1 as a literal first frame it must reproduce. false if it composes from references and has to be TOLD to reproduce one.
_capability_contract.audio_in: true if the route accepts reference audio. Voice character only on every route we have measured — none of them take words from it.
_capability_contract.audio_out: true if the route generates its own audio. Always discarded when the production has cast recordings; kept only when it does not.
_capability_contract.speech: 'generated' if the route invents speech from the prompt (so the prompt must carry NO dialogue and the mouth is driven later), 'none' if silent.
_capability_contract.face_select: true if a lipsync route can be told WHICH face to drive. Every route measured so far says false, which is why speaker boxes exist.
_capability_contract.dur: [min, max] seconds the route will render. Beats shorter than min are shot at min and trimmed.
_capability_contract.grammar: which prompt grammar the compiler emits for this route.

nano-banana.notes: Multi-reference edit. Used for keyframes and stress-test sheets.

human.notes: The director generates it in their own tool and drops the file in. Slowest per image and by some distance the most accurate — a generated keyframe turned an archway into a curtained recess and lost a door bell; the human one held every lock. Default for hero keyframes.

minimax-h3-ref.notes: Composes from references; reproduces a supplied frame reliably when Image 1 is roled as the opening composition and told not to be recomposed. Reference audio fixes voice character only.

minimax-h3-i2v.notes: Guarantees the supplied frame IS the first frame, but cannot carry character sheets alongside it. Use when composition matters more than identity anchoring.

seedance-2.5-ref.notes: One-shots 30s at 1080p with dialogue lip-synced and effects in the same pass. UNVERIFIED on this account — transport not wired. Its generated voice is the wrong way round for a production with a cast; use it for picture and discard the voice, or use it where there is no cast.

elevenlabs-v3.notes: Takes inline performance direction — [hesitant], [pause], [warm, dry amusement]. Performance is written from the script's parentheticals and the character's cadence card, never left to the model.

sync-v2.notes: Drives a mouth from OUR recording. Cannot be told which face — on a multi-face frame it picks one, and it picked the wrong one the first time it ran. Hence speaker boxes.

house._: What THIS production runs. One video model, deliberately: one grammar, one set of quirks, one consistency behaviour to learn.
